findings.title: Cookie "session" is missing HttpOnly, SameSite.
findings.fix: Set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy: no browser-side limit on injected scripts.
findings.fix: Start with default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self' in report-only mode, then enforce it.

findings.title: No HSTS header: browsers may be downgraded to HTTP.
findings.fix: Send Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains once every subdomain supports HTTPS.

findings.title: The server header reveals software and version.
findings.fix: Remove or genericise the header. Then confirm the disclosed product is on a supported, patched version.

findings.title: No security.txt: researchers have no clear way to report a problem.
findings.fix: Publish /.well-known/security.txt with a contact and expiry (RFC 9116).

limitations: Passive check of one URL's response headers, cookies flags and TLS handshake. It cannot see logic flaws, injection, broken access control or anything behind a login.
